sentences: I gave my first conference talk in 2026, and I was terrified.
My slot was at 9 am, right after the opening keynote.
I have attended that conference every year from 2019 to 2025, but never on stage.
The talk went fine, and people asked good questions.
If you are nervous, practise the first minute until it is boring.
notes: in 2026 is a year; at 9 am is a clock time; from 2019 to 2025 is a span of years, not a change a person would animate (TS 17.6). The from-to of years is added to this row because the set must cover it (17.5 coverage, edge cases) and no row of the file plan names it
